channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Buddy Hield | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Buddy Hield from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Buddy Hield, Tre Jones, Nic Claxton, Josh Giddey, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson
item.description:
coach Tiago Splitter said of Hield’s role.

“You’re open, shoot it. When you surround your team with gravity like those guys (Hield and Powell), it opens it up for Caleb (Wilson), Matas (Buzelis) to get to the paint, for Nic (Claxton), for Tre (Jones), Josh (Giddey) – they’re all going to play in the paint.”

Tiago Splitter on Buddy Hield, Tre Jones, Nic Claxton, Josh Giddey, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson, Sep 30, 2026. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“I’m gonna utter some words that have never been said:Buddy Hield you set the tone defensively.”

Steve Kerr on Buddy Hield, Apr 29, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Draymond Green on Buddy Hield
item.description:
“Because I’m in Year 13. Jimmy is in Year 14. He has a way about him. You learn not to mess with guys’ process. We all have our process. I have my process. He goes about things a certain way.… Only Buddy (Hield) said something (to him). But it’s Buddy. Buddy don’t know no better. All of us knew he’ll be more aggressive when it’s time to be aggressive.”

Draymond Green on Buddy Hield, Apr 16, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Steve Kerr on the slumping Buddy Hield:

“I trust him. I put him in the last play because I believe he’ll make the next shot…I’mgonna keep playing him. I’m gonna keep trusting him.”

Steve Kerr on Buddy Hield, Jan 13, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Sixers coach Nick Nurse on if he anticipated that Buddy Hield would need an adjustment period when playing in his first postseason series:

“Listen, Buddy didn’t get much of a chance last night. He did have a couple of plays there. He didn’t play good. It’s game where you can’t extend minutes when a guy has three or four mistakes. But I do say this, he will be a factor in this series.”

Nick Nurse on Buddy Hield, Apr 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Tyrese Haliburton on adjusting without Buddy Hield:

“Yeah, it's been weird for sure. I mean, obviously, I knew at some point we wouldn't be able to play together for my whole career, but obviously with the trade and stuff, it's been different. And I think on the court is obvious, right, without him. He's so prominent in our offense and what we do with a lot of ghost screens and the way that we move, and like his presence shooting on the floor like that opens up a ton for me because you know you're not going to be as much in the Gap if you're guarding Buddy because you know who he is as a shooter. So it's been a little different on the court obviously, but I think off the court has been kind of the biggest adjustment for me.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Buddy Hield, Mar 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Noah Levick:Daryl Morey on Buddy Hield:

“We feel like we got the best player that was traded at the trade deadline.”

Daryl Morey on Buddy Hield, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @NoahLevick.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Buddy Hield
item.description:
The Lakers eventually chose to send Kuzma to Washington along with Montrezl Harrell, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and a pick.

“I was kinda shocked because I thought I was going to Sac.[The trade for] Buddy Hield, that sh*t was done. I’m thinking in my head ‘Okay, well, I’m in Sac’–45-minute flight, not bad. But then out of nowhere, it goes ‘you’re going to Washington,'”

Kyle Kuzma on Buddy Hield, Sep 6, 2021. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Vlade Divac on Buddy Hield
item.description:
“I support his feeling. But for Buddy Hield, he has to look in the mirror and see what he does right and what he does wrong. He’s an elite shooter in this league. But he has to provide that (more consistently). He has to do a better job defensively. It’s hard to win in this league.”

Vlade Divac on Buddy Hield, Aug 15, 2020. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Luke Walton on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Kings coach Luke Walton on Buddy Hield, who played just 11 minutes vs. Pelicans yesterday:

“Buddy still has my trust and we need him. …It was hopefully just a one-game thing there as far as where those minutes were, but he’s a big part of our team.”

Luke Walton on Buddy Hield, Aug 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Jason Jones:Joerger on his late exchange w/ Hield Thursday:

“I was a little animated at a time when the cameras are really on you...that stuff shouldn’t happen out in front. Sometimes you can’t coach off camera.”

Dave Joerger on Buddy Hield, Feb 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: Trae Young on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Young’s lightning-in-a-bottle success brought love, hate and national attention.

“I never let it get to me. It was fun and I enjoyed it. Talking to my dad, talking to a lot of NBA players and [Sacramento Kings and ex-Oklahoma guard] Buddy Hield helped. Buddy got a lot of recognition and won the Wooden Award. They helped guide me and helped me get away from it,”

Trae Young on Buddy Hield, Jun 21, 2018. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Garrett Temple on Vince Carter, Buddy Hield
item.description:
said guard Garrett Temple, who is entering his eighth season.

“If I was a Buddy Hield, I’d be asking Vince Carter question after question,”

Garrett Temple on Vince Carter, Buddy Hield, Sep 26, 2017. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Omri Casspi on DeMarcus Cousins, Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway, Buddy Hield
item.description:
“This is an exciting time for Pelicans fans as we continue our quest for long-term success. I know our fans are equally excited to welcome DeMarcus and Omri to our great city. I want to thank Mr. and Mrs. Benson, Dennis Lauscha and Mickey Loomis for their continued support and providing the resources for us to be successful. I’d also like to thank Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway and Buddy Hield for their professionalism and hard work on the court and in the community during their tenure in New Orleans.”

Omri Casspi on DeMarcus Cousins, Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway, Buddy Hield, Feb 20, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Vlade Divac on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Blake Ellington:Vlade Divac on Buddy Hield:

“Talented guy, I talked to him today. His work ethic is exactly what we want here.”

Vlade Divac on Buddy Hield, Feb 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @BlakeEllington.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Anthony Davis on Hield debut:

“He calls himself Buddy Buckets, and that’s what he did tonight... I’m definitely excited to play with him.”

Anthony Davis on Buddy Hield, Oct 2, 2016. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Alvin Gentry on Buddy Hield:

“He is going to have great shooting games, but he is also going to struggle like every rookie.”

Alvin Gentry on Buddy Hield, Sep 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Buddy Hield
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Alvin Gentry:

“We have had to tell Buddy Hield more than once that he can't come back to the gym at night, or else he won't leave.”

Alvin Gentry on Buddy Hield, Sep 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.
